items.stem: Within this preparation, where may OSCP-style penetration testing techniques be practised?

options.text: Only within an authorised lab or systems you have explicit permission to test

options.text: On any public website that seems insecure

options.text: On a neighbour's network without asking
On any system, because learning justifies it

items.stem: Why is thorough enumeration emphasised before attempting exploitation?

options.text: It reveals the attack surface and guides which paths are worth pursuing
options.rationale: Correct: good enumeration surfaces services and weaknesses that direct the effort.

options.text: It replaces the need to write a report
options.rationale: Reporting is still required regardless of enumeration.

options.text: It guarantees a successful exploit every time

items.stem: Select TWO items that belong in a professional penetration-test report.

options.text: Reproducible steps that demonstrate each finding
options.rationale: Correct: reproducible steps let others verify the finding.
Correct: actionable remediation guidance is a core report element.

options.text: The tester's personal opinions about the client's staff
options.rationale: Personal opinions about staff are unprofessional and out of scope.

options.text: Deliberately vague details so issues cannot be fixed
options.rationale: Vague findings undermine the report's purpose.

options.text: Credentials published openly for anyone to reuse
options.rationale: Publishing credentials is irresponsible and insecure.
